events.title: Leo I crowned Eastern Roman Emperor
events.description: Backed by the powerful general Aspar, Leo I became emperor in Constantinople. He is often said to be the first emperor crowned by the Patriarch, and he reigned until 474.
events.html: Backed by the powerful general Aspar, Leo I became emperor in Constantinople. He is often said to be the first emperor crowned by the Patriarch, and he reigned until 474.

events.title: Edward of Caernarfon becomes the first English Prince of Wales
events.description: Edward I invested his son, the future Edward II, with the title Prince of Wales after his conquest of Wales. The title has been given to the heir to the English and British throne ever since.
events.html: Edward I invested his son, the future Edward II, with the title Prince of Wales after his conquest of Wales. The title has been given to the heir to the English and British throne ever since.

events.title: Austria and Prussia ally against Revolutionary France
events.description: The two German powers signed a defensive alliance amid fears of the French Revolution. War broke out that April, beginning more than two decades of conflict across Europe.
events.html: The two German powers signed a defensive alliance amid fears of the French Revolution. War broke out that April, beginning more than two decades of conflict across Europe.

events.title: Strongest of the New Madrid earthquakes strikes the Mississippi valley
events.description: The last and largest of a series of great earthquakes hit near New Madrid, Missouri. It created waterfalls and made the Mississippi briefly run backwards near the epicentre.
events.html: The last and largest of a series of great earthquakes hit near New Madrid, Missouri. It created waterfalls and made the Mississippi briefly run backwards near the epicentre.

events.title: Great Baltimore Fire begins
events.description: A fire broke out in a dry-goods warehouse and burned for some 30 hours, destroying more than 1,500 buildings in central Baltimore. Fire crews from other cities could not connect hoses to local hydrants.
events.html: A fire broke out in a dry-goods warehouse and burned for some 30 hours, destroying more than 1,500 buildings in central Baltimore. Fire crews from other cities could not connect hoses to local hydrants.

events.title: US embargo on trade with Cuba takes effect
events.description: A proclamation by John F. Kennedy banning almost all imports from Cuba came into force. Extended since, it is one of the longest-lasting trade embargoes in modern history.
events.html: A proclamation by John F. Kennedy banning almost all imports from Cuba came into force. Extended since, it is one of the longest-lasting trade embargoes in modern history.

events.title: Bruce McCandless makes the first untethered spacewalk
events.description: Using a nitrogen-jet backpack, the Manned Maneuvering Unit, McCandless flew about 100 metres from the shuttle Challenger. The photograph of him alone above Earth became famous.
events.html: Using a nitrogen-jet backpack, the Manned Maneuvering Unit, McCandless flew about 100 metres from the shuttle Challenger. The photograph of him alone above Earth became famous.

events.title: Soviet Communist Party agrees to give up its monopoly on power
events.description: The Central Committee accepted Mikhail Gorbachev's proposal to end the party's constitutional leading role. The change opened the way to multi-party politics in the Soviet Union.
events.html: The Central Committee accepted Mikhail Gorbachev's proposal to end the party's constitutional leading role. The change opened the way to multi-party politics in the Soviet Union.
